evidence.text: In the current runtime, stale reservations must be cleared within five minutes.
src/reconciliation/worker.py::run_once scans stale reservations using RECONCILE_INTERVAL_SECONDS, but the supplied source excerpt does not contain the deployed value.

The deployed value and telemetry are unavailable to this research run. Production Operations owns an authorized read-only reconciliation-evidence export containing the deployed RECONCILE_INTERVAL_SECONDS value plus reservation_marked_stale_at and reservation_cleared_at timestamps keyed by reservation ID. A five-minute claim closes only when the export proves every sampled elapsed duration is at most 300 seconds.
